title: Build the PPO clip and the DPO loss
brief: Compute PPO's probability ratio, advantage, and clipped objective, then build the DPO implicit reward, loss, and gradient on top of the Bradley-Terry functions.
hints: policy_ratio is np.exp(new_logps - old_logps). Subtract first, then exponentiate.
advantage: raw = rewards - values; return (raw - raw.mean()) / (raw.std() + 1e-8). With raw all equal the std is 0 and the result must be all zeros.
clipped_objective: np.mean(np.minimum(ratio * advantage, np.clip(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * advantage)). Use minimum, so a bad answer whose ratio rose above 1 + eps keeps its full penalty.
implicit_reward is beta * (policy_logps - ref_logps), elementwise, for whatever shape you are given.
dpo_loss: compute implicit_reward for the chosen answers and for the rejected answers, then return bradley_terry_loss(r_chosen, r_rejected).
dpo_grad: each implicit reward moves by beta per unit of log probability. So multiply both arrays returned by bradley_terry_grad(r_chosen, r_rejected) by beta.
